C0001 has coherent, FDR-supported identity evidence: 21/50 RNA Hallmark pathways with moderate-to-large effect sizes (|SMD| 0.73-0.86) forming a biologically interpretable program (mesenchymal/EMT up, DNA repair up, heme and fatty-acid metabolism down), corroborated by a coherent CNV pattern (12/49 continuous features significant, CDKN2A loss and chr20q gain significant in gain/loss analysis). WXS is weaker and not FDR-significant, but a single strong modality with coherent internal structure is sufficient for retention. Structure and alternative-explanation dimensions are unassessed; no structural probe or confounder report was supplied, and neither is decision-critical for retaining this candidate for downstream validation, since no positive Split/Merge evidence exists and no measured technical factor has been shown to dominate the molecular identity.

C0002 has coherent identity evidence across modalities: a strong CNV signal (18/49 continuous features significant, |delta| 0.56-0.64, all lower in set, plus chr14q and chr8p loss depletion), an FDR-significant WXS finding (PBRM1, q=0.033), and a coherent RNA program (6/50 pathways, |SMD| 0.62-0.96). The modalities point in a consistent direction, supporting a defensible candidate identity. Structure and alternative-explanation dimensions are unassessed; no structural probe or confounder report was supplied, and neither is decision-critical here because no positive Split/Merge evidence exists and no measured technical factor has been shown to dominate the identity.

C0003's identity rests on a single WXS depletion pattern (PBRM1 and VHL depleted, q=0.00047 and 0.0011) that is not mirrored by any FDR-supported RNA (0/50, min q=0.112) or CNV (0/49 continuous, 0/107 gain/loss) finding. The RNA and CNV effects are moderate but non-significant, so the modalities are not coherent and the candidate lacks a coherent, biologically interpretable identity beyond a mutation-frequency difference. No available evidence request can realistically rescue this decision, since the missing dimensions (cross_modal_consistency, confounder_exclusion) would not supply the absent coherent identity signal. Drop is therefore better supported than retention.
